meta.title: Unattributed geostationary drift rate change
meta.authored_by: Claude Opus (illustrative draft, pending Ash authoring)
meta.change_reason: ILLUSTRATIVE content authored to exercise the drill loop, the scoring engine and the interface end to end. Derived only from public open-source material on space domain awareness practice, per the flight plan's public-sources rule. It is NOT a JCO procedure and has not been authored or validated by a subject-matter expert. Ash owns authoring and redaction sign-off; every step, threshold and answer key here is TBC, re-verify.

briefing: A geostationary object under routine custody has moved outside its predicted along-track position. Establish whether this is a manoeuvre, characterise it, and take it to the reporting threshold.
expected_response: Confirm the change in two independent fits before treating it as real.
Exclude a fit artefact by checking epoch spacing and residuals.
Estimate the delta-v and judge it against the platform class.
Classify the manoeuvre and state a confidence.
Confirm the protected-object check was performed before reporting.
